text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — spotted a cluster of mid-market accounts (usage drop week 3->6) that look like classic onboarding gaps. Thinking of a lightweight ‘onboard anchor + downgrade redemption’ micro-play to prevent churn. Quick sync? :wave:
Ethan Rivera: +1. Can you sketch the flow? what triggers, what offer, SLA for outreach?
Maya Chen: Trigger = 25% drop in monthly tokens + no docs opened in 10 days. Flow idea: 1) automated nudge email w/ 1-click enablement checklist, 2) CSM outreach within 48h w/ targeted enablement session, 3) if still low after 14 days -> offer 25% first-month downgrade credit + 1 paid enablement hour.
Priya Patel: Love the tiered offer. Curious on messaging for the email/CTA — want to avoid sounding like a discount-first play. Suggest framing as "remove blockers" + "fast enablement".
Jordan Kim: Ops question — do we have telemetry for "docs opened" event reliably across private deployments? I can run a segment but need confirmation on event name.
csm-bot: Automated note: event 'docs_view' last reported 98% across hosted; private customers show 64% ingestion due to SDK v0.9 gap. See https://internal.metrics/redwood/events/docs_view
Ethan Rivera: Good catch. For private, maybe fallback to "first successful API call" metric. Also recommend splitting recipients: A) high ARR + private -> assign to high-touch CSM, B) low ARR -> email-to-enable flow + auto-assign to enablement playbook.
Maya Chen: Draft email subject options: "Need a minute to unblock <product>?" or "Quick enablement session — on us". Priya — can you draft two variants? one for enterprise tone, one for SMB.
Priya Patel: On it. Will post copy here by EOD. Also adding a short checklist we can include inline:
- quick wins (api key, sample prompt)
- guide link + 3-min video
- book 30m slot (pre-populated times)

Jordan Kim: For Ops: I'll create a segment query: `SELECT customer_id WHERE token_delta_pct <= -25 AND last_docs_viewed_at < now() - interval '10 days'` and export to CS queue. ETA 6 hours.
Ethan Rivera: Can we add a small downgrade path template? wording suggestion: "If you need to adjust capacity for a month, here’s a smooth downgrade path — we’ll keep your data and re-upgrade with 24h notice." Keeps them in the ecosystem.
Maya Chen: Yes — keep it reversible and low-friction. Action items:
- Jordan: segment + export -> CS queue (ETA 6h)
- Priya: email + enterprise/SMB copy (EOD)
- Ethan: downgrade template + Ops notes for billing (tomorrow)
- Maya: draft outreach SLA + playbook doc (I'll post a short runbook)

Ethan Rivera: :thumbsup: One more ask — tie this to renewal score so auto-escalation happens if they hit NPS drop.
Maya Chen: Agreed. Will add renewal_score < 0.4 as an escalation flag. Thanks team — we'll reconvene after assets are posted.
Priya Patel: I'll ping once copy is up. :sparkles:
